english.title: Knowingly / recklessly disclose information obtained under / for the purposes of the Port Security Regulations 2009
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowingly or recklessly

(A)_[and without lawful justification, disclosed information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..) which had been obtained by, or furnished to, you under or for the purposes of the Port Security Regulations 2009]_
(B)_[used information, obtained or furnished for the purposes of the Port Security Regulations 2009, for a purpose other than the purpose of those regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY PURPOSE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 35 of the Port Security Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly / recklessly disclosed information
which had been obtained by / furnished to him / her under or for the purposes of the Port Security Regulations 2009
without lawful justification, as defined in regulation 35(2) of the Regulations

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Regulation 36 creates a defence of due diligence in relation to this offence; in any proceedings against any person for an offence under the Regulations it is a defence for that person to show that they took all reasonable steps and exercised all due diligence to avoid committing the offence.

other.penalty:
Either Way -

Summary: a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
